programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei fall in love. Yet the film turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: Two rival swordsmen, the heroic Fu Hung Hsieh and the wealthy Yen Nan-Fei, must team up to prevent the legendary Peacock Dart from falling into the hands of Mr. Yu and his evil criminal underworld. Traps, poisons, and double-crossings are everywhere in this spooky swordplay thriller from the Shaw Bros. Studio.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: An unparalleled kung-fu masterpiece from the one and only Chang Cheh. The dying Poison Clan master sends his last pupil on a dangerous mission to hunt down the five titular warriors.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: George Lam Tsz-Cheung tries, along with his buddies Hamburger and Snoopy, to find love and success in the world of TV commercials.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Peng fought against many swordsmen and won, so he couldnt accept his first defeat and wanted to suicide. The Sect leader gives him the Full Moon Scimitar on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: Taoist Priest Yu Ji (Cheng Tien-Chi) is a victim of Magistrate Xu Gongs (Wong Lik) desire to kill General Sun Ce (Chiu Gwok) in a grab for power. Gongs plans go awry, as Yu Jis spirit seeks revenge, after being publicly executed.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Chen Hou is a chauffeur who gets caught in a mistaken identity scandal linking him to businesswoman Lok Dai. When a rumor gets out that the two are involved in an affair, shes angry and confronts him.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagles own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: The Sung Dynasty armys Chief Instructor is on a danger-fraught pilgrimage to the Tung Yueh Temple.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong Rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance. Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: Two clans compete for dominance over the martial arts world in this classic of violent swordplay and political intrigue. A complex tale of deception and double crosses. Killer Clans leaves viewers guessing every step of the way. Masterful fight choreography from Yuen Cheung Yan (Yuen Clan member and brother of Yuen Woo Ping) and Tong Gaai fills the screen with bloody sword fighting and imaginative weaponry, delivering both great drama and fantastic martial arts.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husbands murder by the rapist.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei was Hong Kongs most celebrated Queen of Kung-fu. Here she plays a swordswoman on a mission to avenge her parents murders and save the country from foreign invaders.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Lets Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A probation officer tries to help a prisoner who faces harassment from corrupt guards and inmates.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang wrote and directed Tales of Larceny, a story of scams and deceit during the corrupt Chinese Warlord era, featuring top character actors from Shaw Brothers roster.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: Chang Chehs The Water Margin is the martial arts epic of epics. Based on the true legend of how 108 rebels in the mountains were able to repeatedly defeat invading Sung armies.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: As punishment for bad behaviour, the Jade Emperors 7th daughter is banished from heaven and sent to live with the humans. There she falls in love with young villager, Dong Young.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: The glorious Betty Loh Ti stars as a beauty who disguises herself as a boy in order to receive a forbidden education in this multi award-winning drama from director Li Han Hsiang.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: This is a story of adolescent playfulness and innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together, but rivalry intervenes when they discover boys!

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: Wu Sung, a military swordmaster, is acused of murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and a thug, and sent to exile in Meng Chou. At the prison camp, Shih En, son of the camp commander, intercedes in his favour, to spare him the humiliating 100 bamboo lashes.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take it back.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: A recently jailed martial arts master teams up with a wronged woman to take down the mans brother, a coal baron who rules a small town with an iron fist.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: Three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls journey north to masquerade as high society debutantes and make their dreams of a gold-plated walk down the aisle come true.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: 6 swordsmen, among them 2 sisters and their husbands, a lone ranger and a security guard, plot, betray and outwit each other for a load of gold.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: Wang Yu plays a noble martial arts student, whose master and peers are murdered by Lo Liehs bloodthirsty karate expert, and embarks on a tough training regime to avenge them.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: This story happens in an antiquated compound with various types of tenants. A properties developer contended to acquire the properties for redevelopment.

programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor who joins the investigation finds Chois actions suspicious.

programme.title: Those Were The Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Fok Kit is the hottest underground boxer with unbeatable records. To save their boxing studio from being sold, he must win the fight against Shaolin who is known as "Killing Machine". Fok Kit is defeated and badly hurt in the fight, which is a set-up by Lok, who wants to take revenge on Fok Kit’s master, Debo.

programme.title: One And Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club’s top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: An unknown film director who is pursuing his dream and unremittingly pursuing a career in film.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon (2020)
programme.desc: Xu, a rookie officer, manages to solve a robbery case but gets demoted for offending a corrupt senior. He attempts to rise through the ranks by winning the heart of a rich woman.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: A pair of cops go up against an international money-trafficking cartel.

programme.title: Tales From Occult: Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, features three short stories. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Chan Tin Mei (Sammi Cheng) and Ho Bun (Alan Luk)s son passes away abruptly at just three years old due to congenital heart disease. Suffering in unfathomable pain over the loss, Mei resists having another child. One day, Mei finds out that they can become a foster family.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: An urban sketcher suffering from ALS wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. Then, he asks his old classmate to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day.

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: Directorial debut of Man Lim Chung, who spent 3 years filming this documentary about the life and filmmaking philosophy of Ann Hui, one of Hong Kong’s greatest filmmakers. It traces Hui’s life story and her 40-year career’s ups and downs using film footages, candid conversations with Hui, and interviews with her collaborators, family and friends.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs and seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU to find his lost revolver. Ho and his team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: A wealthy entrepreneur goes undercover with an Interpol agent to protect a new invention, the Seed of God, from falling into an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Actor Lau Wai-Chi has a huge following of devoted followers and is always keeping an eye on his rivals. After accepting to play the lead in a modest indie drama, Lau begins the laborious process of mastering the acting skills for the role.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: Hong Kong customs officers discover illegal weapons on a cargo ship and trace them back to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover, uncovering a transnational operation with roots closer to home.

programme.title: Sky On Fire
programme.desc: A security guard becomes embroiled in a battle to protect stem cell research, which can potentially cure cancer, from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: Chi is a property agent who leads an aimless and unfulfilling life until he reunites with his P.E. teacher, Wong, from primary school. Despite his illness, Wong insists on keeping his promise of completing a 10K marathon to his late wife. Inspired by Wong, Chi brings himself to his feet and finds the courage to cheer himself on!

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: About three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost, a boy commits suicide, and some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Chen and his partner Guan are legendary navigators, but in the process of helping a girl Xiao Yu, they must also face their own problems.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: A debt-ridden wedding planner inadvertently becomes a successful funeral planner, but he must convince a traditional Taoist priest of his legitimacy to continue operating in the field.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: The life of a determined young girl is changed when she befriends her buildings concierge, a solitary woman who is more than what she seems.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story known as the Mekong Massacre--two Chinese commercial vessels are ambushed while traveling down the Mekong River in the waters of the Golden Triangle, one of the largest drug-manufacturing regions in the world.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person’s subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The Hong Kong police hunt for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. In an effort to find Painters real identity, the police recruits artist Lee Man to assist in solving the case.

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: A gambling addict and her anti-gambling husband face relationship challenges when she must return to her old ways after criminals target her family.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A 28-year-old IT geek has only been in love once. Surprisingly, he ends up getting romantically involved with five different women this year and the one thing they have in common is that they all live in far flung areas of Hong Kong. After taking five intensive relationship courses within these 365 days, will he find “the-one”?

The documentary takes viewers on a journey through the authentic flavors of Dongguan, showcasing legendary dishes and the blend of tradition and modernity that defines this vibrant city

programme.title: Hafizah
programme.desc: Since childhood, Hafizah ( Olivia Jensen ) has lived in an orphanage without knowing who her parents are. Many people like her simple, cheerful and tomboyish attitude. Unfortunately, on her 18th birthday, Hafizah had to leave the orphanage according to applicable regulations. Hafizahs life changed. He is invited to work at the house of Widuri ( Ade Irawan ), a rich grandmother who is known for being fierce and angry. Hafizahs outspoken attitude resulted in her often clashing with Widuri. Surya ( Ferry Salim ), Widuris son, and wife, Vani ( Cut Tari ), persuade Hafizah to feel at home working. In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.
